retrievalProfile.description: A glamorous close-up portrait featuring soft-focus airbrushing, cool metallic tones, and decorative filigree typography typical of early 2000s R&B aesthetics.
triggerTerms: cool blue and silver metallic palette
excludeWhen: minimalist modern Swiss design is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, slightly tilted close-up portrait of a female subject with smooth, airbrushed skin, wearing a plush fur collar and large jewelry. The color palette is dominated by cool blues, silvers, and deep blacks, with a soft-focus glow and decorative, swirling graphic elements integrated into the lower third.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's face as the primary focal point with a slight diagonal tilt
Contrast between soft fur textures and sharp metallic jewelry
Integration of decorative filigree with the lower typographic block
Cool-toned lighting creating a polished, studio-glamour atmosphere

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale close-up portrait occupying 80% of the frame, positioned slightly off-center with a diagonal lean.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, specifically the one closest to the center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down the bridge of the nose to the lips, then follows the line of the fur collar to the typography in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the subject and fur collar fill most of the frame, with a textured cool-toned background visible in the upper corners.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cool blue-grey and silver (background, fur, and highlights)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and gold jewelry highlights
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value in highlights and deep value in shadows for a metallic sheen.
paletteRestrictions: Limit warm tones to skin and jewelry only

letterConstructionRules: Lowercase display text with extended terminals
Integration of swirling, organic filigree lines into the letterforms
High contrast between thick and thin strokes in the serif elements
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'n' and 'v' in the primary name often feature elongated, decorative tails that blend into background swirls.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A decorative, lowercase serif for the name paired with a clean, all-caps sans-serif for the title.

candidateDirections.reason: High contrast serifs provide the necessary elegance.
Clean geometric sans-serif for secondary information.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up glamour portrait of a woman with a diagonal head tilt, wearing a large grey fur collar and ornate earrings. Use cool blue-grey studio lighting with soft-focus airbrushed skin. Leave the bottom right corner clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in a decorative lowercase serif font in the bottom right. Integrate silver swirling filigree ornaments that wrap around the letters and bleed into the fur texture. Add a secondary title in a small, clean sans-serif below the name.

verificationChecks: Is the skin texture smooth and airbrushed?
Does the color palette feel cool and metallic?
Is the typography integrated with decorative swirls?
Is the subject's head tilted diagonally?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue color grade
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
postGenerationChecks: Check for smooth skin transitions without digital artifacts
Ensure the fur looks plush and detailed
Verify the typography is legible despite the decorative swirls
Confirm the diagonal composition feels balanced
recipe.reuseFormula: Glamour Portrait + Cool Blue/Silver Grade + Fur Texture + Filigree Typography = Y2K R&B Aesthetic
